title: After Hours
tagline: It's after midnight. Do you know where your dinner is?
about: A word processor's night out in SoHo spirals into one bizarre disaster after another.
cue: Serve the bagels when Kiki shows off her bagel and cream cheese paperweights.
faces: Julie takes care of the tables. Tom pours.
The fare went up at midnight. Ours did not.
Hand-formed chuck, salted right before the flat top, cooked medium under melted cheddar. Raw onion, dill pickles, toasted bun.
Three decks of toast with roast chicken, crisp bacon, lettuce, tomato and mayo, pinned and cut in four. Chips alongside.
Toasted minis spread thick with chive and black pepper cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers, sesame, poppy seed and garlic.
Hand cut, fried twice, plenty of salt.
Vanilla butter layers under seven-minute frosting, roughed up with a palette knife to set white and matte.
For the sculptors on the block.
Vanilla soft serve dipped in dark chocolate that sets to a shell, then crushed peanuts or sprinkles.
Bourbon, lemon, a little sugar and egg white shaken silky, bitters on the foam, a cherry.
Rye or bourbon with a draft back.
Fresh pot all night, refills free.
The bar, a quiet night after midnight.
Lock up, there have been burglaries on the block. Off to Club Berlin? Eat first.
Cash only. Prices subject to change. Form 1985.
